description: This file defines a Tiptap extension for creating and managing tables within a rich text editor, including commands, plugins, and schema extensions.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: A Tiptap node extension for creating and managing tables with configurable options.

methods.name: addOptions
methods.description: Provides default options for the Table extension, including HTML attributes, resizable flag, cell minimum width, and node view.

methods.name: parseHTML
methods.description: Defines how to parse HTML elements into the table node.

methods.name: renderHTML
methods.description: Renders the table node as an HTML table element with appropriate attributes and child elements.

methods.name: addCommands
methods.description: Defines commands for inserting tables, adding/removing rows and columns, merging/splitting cells, toggling headers, setting cell attributes, navigating cells, fixing table structure, and setting cell selection.

methods.name: addKeyboardShortcuts
methods.description: Provides keyboard shortcuts for navigating and editing tables, such as Tab, Shift-Tab, and delete keys.

methods.name: addProseMirrorPlugins
methods.description: Adds ProseMirror plugins for table resizing and editing functionalities.

methods.name: extendNodeSchema
methods.description: Extends the node schema to include a configurable table role.
